# Critique Pass Two — Thirty Additional Improvements

The Awtsmoos asks each vessel if it serves truth or merely looks complete;
Awtsmoos.com keeps only changes whose evidence, privacy, and speed can meet.

1. A coverage auditor must not itself become a second canonical registry.
2. Read generated artifacts instead of duplicating registry resolution logic when possible.
3. Runtime crawl must cap concurrency to avoid self-DoS.
4. Runtime crawl must cap total URLs for ordinary CI and support explicit deep mode.
5. HTTP checks must distinguish intended redirects from canonical redirects.
6. Metadata coverage must consider authored tags plus generated tags together.
7. H1 audit should be advisory unless page type contract requires one.
8. Structured data must parse as JSON.
9. Structured data must use canonical URL.
10. Structured data title must match document title after entity decoding.
11. Alias ProfilePage schema should not claim unsupported social identities.
12. Post Article schema should not claim publication dates if absent.
13. Breadcrumb schema should use real parent titles only.
14. Comment schema should wait until parent/reply semantics are mapped truthfully.
15. Translation `hreflang` should wait until there are genuinely paired standalone language URLs.
16. Core sitemap should stay curated, not auto-enumerate every top-level directory.
17. Donate should remain excluded until it has meaningful authored semantics.
18. Login/logout/control/admin/edit/submit/delete/debug/internal paths remain excluded.
19. Public catalogs should not index broken registry entries.
20. Generated metadata should omit entries whose files do not exist.
21. Add file-existence check to metadata builder if absent.
22. Add test proving external registry links cannot enter metadata artifacts.
23. Add test proving fragments/query strings are removed from canonicals.
24. Add test proving explicit `.html` routes preserve file semantics.
25. Add test proving extensionless directory paths gain trailing slash.
26. Ensure generated cleanup cannot delete hand-authored files.
27. Ensure generated shards are stable in ordering.
28. Ensure no generated shard exceeds 120 lines.
29. Document current real-data absence of authored alias posts rather than fabricating a live example.
30. Production release must re-verify exact public origin after activation, not rely on local tests.
